entries.scope: A paired native tables file and RocksDB checkpoint.
entries.assertion: Require complete identical nonempty key streams, pinned table identity, exact entry count and same-snapshot checkpoint stamp; distinguish semantic equality and canonical encoding differences.
entries.rationale: Zero semantic differences alone can pass without a comparison.
entries.resolution: The pinned original preprod table and same-snapshot checkpoint passed complete nonempty key/semantic comparison and canonical packing for all 4,526,058 outputs; see exact-source external acceptance receipt.

entries.scope: 2,219 retained witness rows: 2,207 native calls and 12 malformed-length non-calls.
entries.assertion: Replay 1,121 accepts and 1,086 rejects directly; require exact typed length rejection for each of the twelve non-calls.
entries.rationale: Older Scala agreement is regression evidence, not an independent oracle; a native non-call is not a native rejection.
entries.resolution: Retain direct archive replay, exact row counts and malformed-input negative controls without changing native outcomes.

entries.scope: Fifty Byron projection rows and their original block headers.
entries.assertion: Assert independently decoded chain points and explicit current projection fields; retain historical digest rows.
entries.rationale: The existing top-level shape check does not prove field values; a local Praos-shaped projection is not native PBFT state equivalence.
entries.resolution: Retain original digest bytes and exact original-header/prepared-Shelley-view expectations; add independent PBFT-state coverage before claiming native PBFT equivalence.

entries.scope: Auxiliary-data entries in the committed block goldens.
entries.assertion: Compare complete auxiliary-data CBOR payloads as well as transaction positions.
entries.rationale: Position equality cannot detect altered payload bytes.
entries.resolution: Retain exact corpus counts, full payload comparisons and the tampered-payload negative control.

entries.scope: Twelve external-data tests; five optional benchmarks are a separate performance contract.
entries.assertion: Candidate acceptance must provision pinned input identities and reject missing, skipped or unreported required cases.
entries.rationale: Normal unit-test success does not establish acceptance for absent private or large offline inputs.
entries.resolution: All twelve pinned external-data cases and all 66 additional controls passed without skips, missing cases or failures. Actual source/runtime, complete input identities and JUnit hashes are retained in the reviewed receipt.

entries.scope: The retained fresh-ledger and multi-ledger native refusal observations.
entries.assertion: Compare every complete encoded predicate-failure list, including cardinality, order and multiplicity, against unchanged native bytes.
entries.rationale: One-cause membership could not detect omitted or reordered failures; the diagnostic adapters now run complete accumulation.
entries.resolution: All original fresh-ledger and multi-ledger cases compare complete native refusal bytes. The LEDGERS adapter mirrors the native outer fold, bounded TxIx enumeration and sub-rule nesting; production block application keeps its first-failure policy. Both rejected native batches fail the first-failure negative control. This is bounded to the recorded inputs, not complete era/family coverage (#401).

entries.scope: Recorded Preview replay against required reduced native projection bodies, separately from Scala serial/parallel execution equivalence.
entries.assertion: Require nonempty original reference bodies for every indexed in-window point; compare every required native field exactly, including complete map digests/counts/buckets, and require referenceBodyComparisons == referenceTargetsRequired > 0.
entries.rationale: An export is an input to a comparison and must not be reported as completed native parity.
entries.resolution: All 8,380 original Preview blocks passed Scala execution-mode comparison; the one required authentic in-window native reference body was fully compared, with all nine ordered expected invalid transaction identities reproduced and no collection/unavailability failures. Broader historical native equality is outside this bounded run.

entries.scope: Pinned recorded Mithril artifact/checkpoint restoration and optional projection export.
entries.assertion: Check artifact provenance, restored anchor and UTxO count, then construct a projection; no independent native projection body is loaded or compared.
entries.rationale: Constructing or exporting a projection cannot establish native projection-content equivalence.
entries.resolution: Keep the restore/construction claim explicit and separate from historically recorded external comparisons. Native-body equivalence needs an independent comparison and its own retained receipt.

entries.scope: All 17 original generated-cache contexts (nine native accepts and eight refusals), separately counted from 39 coherent-state inputs.
entries.assertion: Replay unchanged complete native accepted state fields and UTxO entries under the documented byte adapter; compare every native refusal as a complete encoded list, including order and multiplicity. Pin 58 observations and 56 distinct rule inputs (37 accepts, 19 refusals).
entries.rationale: The discrepancy was checked signed arithmetic versus native modular Word64 arithmetic and missing-entry insertion, not an evidenced native cache-coherence precondition.
entries.resolution: Match modular arithmetic, absent-entry insertion, zero removal and native TxIn deletion order; retain checked CompactCoin construction, seven source-derived controls and all original fixture bytes. The refusal side now compares complete accumulated lists, including all eight original generated-cache refusals (#412).

entries.scope: Configured ChainSync header, LeiosFetch and LeiosNotify CDDL seed catalogs, including their declared imports and existing wire adapters.
entries.assertion: Every requested sample is required; missing modules/rules, unsupported grammar and sampling cycles fail. Require 120 samples per formerly empty catalog and all 8/5/8 constructor tags.
entries.rationale: Optional partial-module fallbacks previously converted unsupported or unresolved batches into empty vectors; restored imports supply the intended configured schemas.
entries.resolution: Retain strict batch counts and negative controls; 360 actual samples passed independent Cuddle 1.8.1 validation against the composed schemas, including existing base.word16 and tx=any adapters. This is schema membership, not signed Cardano transaction admission.

entries.scope: Public generated constructors, preserved field/raw consistency and optional array layouts.
entries.assertion: Generated case classes and copied preserved values can violate greedy optional layout or field/raw consistency; the checked writer does not currently guarantee these contracts.
entries.rationale: Byte-only round trips do not prove member consistency. Pinned Cuddle inline backtracking differs from its spliced-group behavior; RFC8610 greedy semantics support retaining the current Scala matching rule rather than treating validator acceptance alone as normative validity.
entries.resolution: Implement typed checked construction/member validation, including preserved field/raw coherence and optional presence, while retaining greedy matching and independent group controls. Keep the reproduced validator observations distinct from expected normative behavior; tracked by M13/#86.

entries.scope: 476 Wycheproof rows: 242 compact-signature builtin cases and 234 DER boundary cases.
entries.assertion: Assert every row classification; DER cases compare structural/strict canonical decoding and are not passed as compact builtin signatures.
entries.rationale: The builtin signature ABI is fixed-width compact form; DER bytes are a different input format.
entries.resolution: Retain explicit DER assertions, original vectors and exact 242 compact/234 DER-boundary counts.

entries.scope: 63,490 non-NaN half-float patterns and one canonical-NaN control; the 2,046 NaN payload patterns are not individually asserted.
entries.assertion: Every non-NaN pattern round-trips exactly; the separate Float.NaN assertion yields canonical 0x7e00.
entries.rationale: IEEE NaN payload preservation is not the conversion contract; the current identity loop excludes NaNs.
entries.resolution: Retain the canonicalization distinction; strengthen all NaN-pattern assertions without claiming bit identity.

entries.scope: Pinned native mux corpus: 32 rows, 22 native-result rows and 10 precondition non-results.
entries.assertion: All eligible native results are checked; precondition failures remain retained and classified separately.
entries.rationale: An upstream precondition failure produces no codec verdict and must not be counted as agreement.
entries.resolution: Keep exact source-pinned eligibility and counts; expand coverage using independently valid inputs.

entries.scope: Probabilistic ledger-peer selection tests.
entries.assertion: Bounded samples check statistical tolerance, not equality to a native random schedule.
entries.rationale: Independent random schedules do not have identical draws; statistical checks state their confidence and sample size.
entries.resolution: Keep assertions and published tolerances aligned; correct stale sigma descriptions when changing this suite.

entries.scope: Maintained native snapshot V5 fixtures versus retired V1-V4 layouts.
entries.assertion: Current native V5 fixtures are mandatory; version refusal and migration tests have their own explicit format contracts.
entries.rationale: Retired-format boundaries do not waive current native decoding.
entries.resolution: Retain pinned native provenance and previous-version migration tests whenever a persisted format changes.

entries.scope: Native ledger UTxO result comparisons in fresh-ledger and multi-ledger suites.
entries.assertion: Compare every MemPack field, every non-raw TxOut field, aggregate UTxO accounting and remaining ledger state; signed transaction body/witness bytes have separate original-byte assertions.
entries.rationale: The native compact output does not retain historical original output CBOR. Clearing TxOut.raw in a semantic result comparison does not establish original output-byte identity.
entries.resolution: Keep semantic and original signed-byte assertions separate; add an independent byte-preservation oracle before claiming historical output-byte equality.

entries.scope: Removal of four legacy debug-ledger answer masks and rounded numeric projection comparisons, integrated by PR #285.
entries.assertion: Same-point query answers require complete wire-byte equality and valid debug-state framing; native projection comparisons use exact represented values without decimal rounding.
entries.rationale: This bounded contract does not establish universal ledger equivalence: projection comparison checks reference fields and digests, permits extra Scala fields and excludes era metadata. Historical masked receipts remain qualified.
entries.resolution: Retain the unmasked private-native receipt on runtime d9d089039 (330/330 query answers, including 20 debug-state pairs) separately from final f7795522 CI (6,915 passed, 17 skipped). Neither receipt establishes the twelve-case external candidate campaign.

entries.scope: Pre-Conway ShelleyInstantStakeOps credential and pointer caches, separately from the nine corrected Conway cases: 32 native cases (16 per map) run under the Shelley and the Babbage TxOut, and 6 toCompact bounds. Not the full UTXO transition, the Alonzo/Babbage collateral path as a transition, or any other era.
entries.assertion: The production updater matches the results of the actual released addShelleyInstantStake and deleteShelleyInstantStake (cardano-ledger f649f975, Shelley/State/Stake.hs:108-145; the released source file is byte-identical to the pin), run in the order of updateUTxOAndInstantStake, for underflow, overflow to zero, missing-entry insertion for both operations, zero suppression, zero removal and reinsertion, addition before deletion and TxIn map order, in both maps. ShelleyInstantStakeReferenceSuite replays every case through the updater and through ShelleyUtxo.update with inputs in signed order; ShelleyInstantStakeArithmeticSuite keeps the checked output-coin bounds.
entries.rationale: Correcting the Conway corpus does not establish parity for the analogous earlier-era updater; no cache-coherence precondition justifies ignoring these source differences.
entries.resolution: Native results captured with scripts/oracle/instant-stake in the pinned reference image (provenance in fixtures/reference/instant-stake/provenance.json) and replayed; the arithmetic and traversal order are aligned and checked input conversion is preserved.

entries.scope: 912 explicit input cases invoking all five unchanged pinned Haskell peer-selection policies.
entries.assertion: Compare complete selected peer sets and optional hot-demotion scores for every eligible peer using identical unsigned Word32 draws.
entries.rationale: Selected sets and score maps are observable native outputs; different PRNG implementations do not justify mapping or masking those outputs. These cases are explicit boundaries, not an original upstream generator corpus.
entries.resolution: Production-used ranking functions replay every retained native case with no exclusions. Governor integration tests cover ordinary, local-root and big-ledger activation. No identical PRNG stream or thread schedule is claimed.

entries.scope: All 84 retained original Genesis scenarios, every one of the 21 native property branches, and their complete typed runtime observations.
entries.assertion: Execute every original property and allowed-exception constraint; compare complete selected fragments and every native peer/component multiplicity exactly; enforce every original CSJ download bound, typed cause attribution, production refusal-decision-before-termination, per-peer cleanup causality, complete ordered GDD callback consumption and absence of defects/invariants. Compare all 1,304 native GDD decisions and 45 ordered callback batches exactly.
entries.rationale: The original DensityDisconnect property explicitly permits DensityTooLow or CandidateTooSparse. CSJ and Uniform constrain their original trace/safety properties plus the shared closed expected-exception set, rather than a cross-peer finalizer schedule. Complete native and Scarab observations remain retained; concrete component counts, typed causes and required causal orders are asserted without exclusions or tolerance.
entries.resolution: Retain the pinned finite corpus, closed exhaustive scenario-law evaluator, negative controls and original native inputs; source freshness watches generators, properties and production mechanisms.

entries.scope: Complete pinned public mainnet Byron genesis and mainnet/Preview lightweight checkpoint inputs.
entries.assertion: Verify original public input hashes; reject malformed, duplicate or out-of-range checkpoint entries; enforce configured checkpoint hashes in canonical header and full block paths across eras.
entries.rationale: These are original public configuration inputs and boundary regressions, not exported native checkpoint-rejection verdicts. The complete mainnet genesis check always executes without an environmental skip.
entries.resolution: Preserve exact public payloads and pinned provenance; keep typed hash/parser/enforcement regressions and the always-running complete-genesis check.

entries.scope: All 72 native tentative-header traces (4,178 transitions), original signed Conway header projection, opaque punishment DSL and four actual ChainDB classifications.
entries.assertion: Compare complete typed state and every outcome without filtering; preserve invalid-prefix punishment, repeated-identity rejection and client reset.
entries.rationale: Native CardanoBlock instances and ChainDB callbacks provide independent observations; deterministic supplementary traces are not claimed as upstream-generated inputs or exhaustive coverage.
entries.resolution: Retain original native observations, source and exporter identities, and strict comparisons across every currently supported era.

entries.scope: All 29 pinned native parameter and fee-policy decoder cases, including 21 accepted states and 66 exact fee outcomes.
entries.assertion: Compare complete decoded parameter state, signed Nano normalization, arbitrary Natural values and every native fee result or typed arithmetic error with operands; retain all rejected decoder rows.
entries.rationale: The actual pinned Byron and binary packages supply the oracle. These finite boundary cases and separate JSON-source regressions do not claim exhaustive wire-decoder coverage.
entries.resolution: Preserve all native inputs and outcomes, checked original mainnet transaction regressions and unchanged persisted field layout.

entries.scope: All 24 constructed homogeneous PBFT or Praos view cases, including every input permutation, eligibility decision, complete sorted order and pairwise Ord result.
entries.assertion: Compare native configured preferCandidate independently of unrestricted global Ord; retain every candidate, stable tie, EBB distinction and certificate comparison.
entries.rationale: Actual pinned SelectView instances and Data.List.sortBy provide the oracle. These finite protocol-view examples are not upstream-generated schedules, signed-header validity cases or cross-era HFC coverage.
entries.resolution: Preserve all 24 original inputs and outputs, pinned observer provenance and strict complete-field comparisons; project every runtime path through LoE and eligibility before ranking.

entries.scope: All seven explicitly constructed synthetic comparator cases observed through the recorded native Data.List.sortBy executable.
entries.assertion: Compare every complete sorted vector and every pairwise comparison, including six input permutations and the mixed seven-element case; preserve stable ties and native run boundaries.
entries.rationale: This separately observes the native sorting mechanism under a synthetic nontransitive comparator. It does not claim Praos global Ord is restricted or nontransitive, lawful signed-header inputs, upstream-generated vectors or exhaustive sorting coverage.
entries.resolution: Retain all seven independent native observations and compiler/executable provenance, plus small-stack width regressions; keep protocol-view eligibility coverage in its separate contract.

entries.scope: All 55 constructed actual Cardano HFC view comparisons: all 42 ordered cross-era pairs from Byron through Conway, seven same-era controls and six near-slot, chain-length or certificate-boundary cases.
entries.assertion: Compare every native Ord result, both configured preferCandidate directions and the complete sorted identity vector; require all 42 ordered cross-era pairs and preserve every original row.
entries.rationale: The actual pinned HardForkProtocol Cardano instances supply independent observations. These finite differential examples are separate from the homogeneous protocol-view and synthetic sort corpora; they are not upstream-generated or signed-header validity cases.
entries.resolution: Preserve the complete native HFC payload and provenance, enforce later-era shared eligibility configuration and retain no cross-era tie-breaker between Byron and Shelley-based eras.

entries.scope: 798 explicit native low/high decision outputs and 24 retained original upstream-generated low/high final-chain scenarios.
entries.assertion: Compare full native action and continuation state for identical policy inputs; replay original scenarios through receiver-observed rolling runtime with unchanged depth pairs, intersections and complete producer chains, bounded outstanding requests and zero before Done.
entries.rationale: Explicit native decision grids and original generated protocol scenarios provide distinct evidence. Complete-message readiness and immediate receiver callbacks must be exercised through the production API, rather than inferred from legacy fixed-batch final chains.
entries.resolution: No original inputs or native outcomes are replaced, masked or excluded. Production defaults are 200/300; original scenarios retain their own generated marks. Exact thread schedules are not inferred from functional outcomes.

entries.scope: 1,152 explicit native IOSim cases invoking the unchanged pinned peerChurnGovernor, including 13,824 first-cycle actions.
entries.assertion: Compare complete initial and post-head-start targets, every raw target proposal, sanity flags, signed achieved changes, timeout outcomes and native picosecond wait values for every retained case.
entries.rationale: Genesis and Praos choose different startup targets, regimes and intervals. Raw invalid targets remain observable churn inputs even when the peer governor ignores them. These are explicit boundary cases, not an upstream generator corpus.
entries.resolution: Production decision helpers and notification-driven runtime tests retain all native outputs, including negative active targets and root/known mismatches. Native PRNG streams and wall-clock thread schedules are not equated.

entries.scope: Nine explicit native BigLedgerPeers requests, with absent, empty or nonempty ledger answers and requested counts 0, 1 and 4.
entries.assertion: Compare the production BigLedgerRoots.fromLedger adapter against complete native offered partitions, origins and configured advertisement flags for every captured case.
entries.rationale: Configured fallback peers belong to ordinary public roots; only actual ledger answers belong to the big-ledger partition. Empty and absent ledger answers are different values.
entries.resolution: All nine directly generated native Big-request cases are retained. Actual static/dynamic provider and governor tests separately verify TTLs, root-generation behavior and initial known-peer advertisement flags. The unchanged All-request classifier is outside this adapter boundary.

entries.scope: 384 unchanged native active-state observations across eight seeds, both peer trust values and both idle settings, plus seven unsigned Word64 boundaries.
entries.assertion: Compare every captured deadline using the production client receive-state selector or effective server idle setting, exact binary timeout samples and picoseconds; verify complete retained RNG advancement and random scaling boundaries.
entries.rationale: Untrustable MustReply deadlines are freshly randomized601–911seconds. Trustable local-root clients are unbounded, other states do not consume random input, and partial reads retain a single state budget.
entries.resolution: Every native output is retained without masks or exceptions. Native and JVM PRNG seed streams are not equated; actual native Word64 samples drive identical production scaling. Runtime tests independently exercise hook ordering, trust, fresh state draws and fragmented reads.

entries.scope: Devnet ledger comparisons of the e2e scenario (every Shelley-based era) and of pool, relay, soak and restart (Conway): the reference ledger projected onto the Scala /state shape at one block.
entries.assertion: Every projected field is equal, with no masks or tolerances; compare.PROJECTION_SCOPE lists the compared fields and names each omission found by auditing the eraview and govview projections, nested ones included, and e2e-summary.json carries it under ledgerComparison.scope; each result lists the top-level Scala fields without a reference counterpart (scalaOnlyKeys). Reference-script hashes are taken over the original script bytes, the Conway UTxO and proposal roots (prevGovActionIds) come from LocalStateQuery under an overall session deadline, cross-checked against the CLI UTxO, and each nested omission has a control test showing two states that differ only there project identically.
entries.rationale: A projection is not whole-state equality. Not compared: cost models, Conway protocol parameters other than the version, previous and future parameters before Conway, ParameterChange values, reward-account networks (future pool parameters, return accounts, treasury withdrawals), whether a pool's reward credential is a key or a script, pool relays, metadata and delegators (all Conway pool parameters), account pointers, snapshot pool parameters, stake-distribution fractions and VRF keys, DRep anchors and delegators, committee member status, enact withdrawals, the treasury donation, nonMyopic, individual reward entries, the pulsing reward state, instantaneous stake and AVVM/Byron state. Counts such as 66/66 describe projected comparisons only.
entries.resolution: Covered once every era's comparison checks the complete ledger state (for example same-point DebugNewEpochState and whole-UTxO bytes, as ntc does for Conway) or the projection omits nothing.

entries.scope: Expected reference refusals of the e2e load (expect_reject and expect_rejected in eraload).
entries.assertion: A refusal counts only when it names every expected predicate failure as a whole constructor; each evidence row records whether the reference's failure list is exactly the expected failures (exact), holds others too (contains) or could not be read (unparsed), and e2e-summary.json counts both under refusalMatches.
entries.rationale: These cases check the reference's verdict for transactions built to break one rule; the Scala rules replay the refused bytes in unit tests. A containment match is recorded as such, never reported as an exact list.
entries.resolution: Retain whole-constructor matching, the list-match label and its negative controls in scripts/tests/test_devnet_pure.py.

entries.scope: Refused cases of V1ContextSuite (v1-context, context-errors submissions and plutus-boundaries transactions).
entries.assertion: The one cause the recorded reference text names (validation-tag mismatch, or a translation error and its source) is exactly the failure the Scala phase-2, transaction and block rules give.
entries.rationale: The recorded texts are cut at 1,500 characters and most cases keep no raw reason, so neither the reference's whole failure list nor the encoded reason is compared.
entries.resolution: Covered once each refused case carries the reference's raw reason and a node-module suite asserts the encoded Scala refusal equals it byte for byte.

entries.scope: 26 exact native scalar-value, UTF8, literal-parser and retained byte-length observations.
entries.assertion: Compare every acceptance/value/UTF8/length/measure field; preserve public constructor/copy/Product/Mirror contracts and immutable construction-time measurement.
entries.rationale: Java surrogate replacement and 16-bit escape truncation differ from native scalar Text; repeated encoding is not a stored measure.
entries.resolution: NativeTextReferenceSuite enforces the complete bounded fixture. Generic foreign Flat/helpers and native CEK budget/demand semantics are outside this representation/parser scope.

entries.scope: Transactions the released reference node refused over node-to-client LocalTxSubmission in all six Shelley-based eras, with the ledger state, UTxO and genesis each was judged against; the families each era must cover are declared in the manifest. Byron transaction-error coverage is not established.
entries.assertion: Replay every case through Scarab (Conway: LocalSubmission and MempoolState.add on the reference's ticked state; Shelley through Babbage: the era's LEDGER rule and PreConwayFailureCbor) and require the complete ApplyTxErr bytes, every accumulated failure in order; every required family per era must have a case.
entries.rationale: First-failure comparisons cannot show check-order regressions or a missing accumulated failure, and replays of accepted chains never contain a refused transaction.
entries.resolution: Covered when every recorded case compares equal and the complete required era/family scope is covered (#401). The 2026-10-26 corpus has 105 transactions comprising 103 complete byte comparisons and two incomplete PlutusFailure-text comparisons (#491). Those two remove only that text for the partial comparison, assert the original bytes still differ and cancel; they are not conformance passes. Other differing cases fail.

entries.scope: All 302 original JSONTestSuite parsing inputs in aeson 2.2.5.0 plus 48 controls; every raw byte, native admission result and complete accepted Value event stream.
entries.assertion: First-wins only after validating every value; directly compare object iteration and unnormalized Scientific coefficient/exponent. All350 cases run on a small-stack thread. Native errors retained, Scala diagnostic text not claimed identical.
entries.rationale: Circe admission differs on duplicate choice, original malformed tokens, nesting depth and exponent representation. This unused primitive does not establish genesis loader or field-level conformance.
entries.resolution: Keep all upstream inputs and exact native replay; integrate raw genesis loaders and close field-level/order gaps separately.
